name: Synthetic and AI-Generated Identity and Deepfake Onboarding
description: Fraudsters combine real and fabricated data, or use generative tools to create faces, voices and documents, to pass remote onboarding. The accounts then bear credit abuse, mule activity or laundering. Detection depends on layered identity proofing and behavioural signals across the customer lifecycle.

sources.text: FinCEN, Alert on Fraud Schemes Involving Deepfake Media Targeting Financial Institutions (FIN-2024-Alert004, 2024)

indicators.name: Identity with thin or recently created credit and data footprint
indicators.canon: Synthetic identity with thin or newly created footprint
indicators.desc: Thin or recently created credit and digital footprint, with mixed attributes suggesting a fabricated identity.
indicators.ctx: Identifiers appear in few databases, with recent first use and mixed data elements.

indicators.name: Selfie or video shows signs of synthetic or injected media
indicators.canon: Selfie or video shows signs of synthetic or injected media
indicators.desc: Liveness checks reveal artefacts, virtual cameras or replayed streams.
indicators.ctx: Liveness checks reveal artefacts, virtual cameras or replayed streams.

indicators.name: Document images share templates, fonts or backgrounds across applicants
indicators.canon: Documents or images reused or templated across applicants
indicators.desc: Same document image, selfie, template, font or background appears across different applicants or after rejection.
indicators.ctx: Multiple applications use near-identical layouts or reused photos.

indicators.name: Mismatch between claimed identity and device, IP or voice
indicators.canon: Mismatch between claimed identity and device, IP or voice
indicators.desc: Geolocation, language or voice biometrics inconsistent with the stated identity.
indicators.ctx: Geolocation, language or voice biometrics inconsistent with the stated identity.

indicators.name: Same contact details used with different identities
indicators.canon: Multiple customers sharing contact details or addresses
indicators.desc: Unrelated customers or applicants share the same phone, email, address, device or bank account, including mail drops and shared accommodation.
indicators.ctx: Phone or email repeated under varied names or birthdates. Many identities share one address or commercial drop.

indicators.name: Rapid credit build then bust or large cash-out
indicators.canon: Sudden credit utilisation spike then bust-out
indicators.desc: Credit builds up and is then rapidly utilised to limit or cashed out after a period of low use.
indicators.ctx: Account builds limits quickly then draws maximum funds.

indicators.name: Voice or video call authentication challenges failed
indicators.canon: Voice or video call authentication challenges failed
indicators.desc: Callers using cloned voices or video deepfakes during high-value requests.
indicators.ctx: Callers using cloned voices or video deepfakes during high-value requests.

indicators.name: Applications following failed attempts with edited data
indicators.canon: Applications following failed attempts with edited data
indicators.desc: Repeated retries altering one data element until approval.
indicators.ctx: Repeated retries altering one data element until approval.

indicators.name: Dates of birth, SSN or national ID not matching authoritative records
indicators.canon: Dates of birth, SSN or national ID not matching authoritative records
indicators.desc: Authoritative checks fail or show multiple identities on one number.
indicators.ctx: Authoritative checks fail or show multiple identities on one number.
